**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** yes

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Resumable code cannot capture `{name}`: class instances are not serializable
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Create the instance inside the handler (or a clientEffect), build it with `reconstruct(() => new Foo())` from `@rivetjs/runtime/dom` (or `/server` in a server-only module; no value in the page; the browser runs the factory on first read), or capture plain data/signals instead of a `new …` value.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { Foo } from "foo-sdk";
export function A() { const f = new Foo(); return <button onClick={() => console.log(f.n)} />; }
```

```tsx prefer
import { Foo } from "foo-sdk";
export function A() { return <button onClick={() => console.log(new Foo().n)} />; }
```

## Quick fix

The [language service](../guides/tooling/language-service.md) (editor) and the MCP `check_code` tool offer this code action:

- Build it in the browser: `reconstruct(() => …)` → `const x = reconstruct(() => <init>)`; reads become `x()` (+ import from @rivetjs/runtime/dom)

## When it is reported

Resume mode; syntax-only (`const x = new X()` / class expression). Since Function Bridge T24 not for a data class declared in the module (it registers and resumes as data) nor an import of a `.tsx` / `.jsx` module (that module registers it); ineligible module classes are RV2102. Type-aware twin: RV2101.
